description: Database engine: sqlite, postgres, mysql, oracle
SQLite: absolute path to the database file
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: server host name or address
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: TCP port (default 5432 for PostgreSQL, 3306 for MySQL, 1521 for Oracle)
PostgreSQL, MySQL: database to connect to (for MySQL, also the default schema). Oracle: the service name (FREEPDB1, ORCLPDB1)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: login role, account or user
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: the login's password (a secret: env var or OS credential store)
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle: connect over TLS (Oracle: TCPS), verifying the server's certificate against the OS store
